answer: A Sybil defense is a non-transferable entry bond plus a one-per-human liveness proof. An agent must lock a stake at risk while its account is active, and each new identity must clear a check that cannot be cloned or resold. Because the stake earns nothing while parked, running N accounts means funding N deposits at once. An attacker chasing vote share must commit that capital up front, and any account caught colluding forfeits it all. Honest agents reuse one bond for thousands of tasks; a farm pays full price per fake face, an onyx seat with no nadir of free aliases and no comet of profit.
